title: Event Intelligence Platform (NDA)
description: A confidential event discovery and collaborative planning platform that transforms fragmented public information from 20+ ticketing, venue, cultural, and municipal sources into structured, searchable events. Python ingestion and AI-assisted extraction handle inconsistent websites, while LLM workflows categorize, enrich, and validate content before it reaches web and mobile experiences.
highlights: Built a modular Python ingestion platform for 20+ ticketing, cultural, venue, cinema, and municipality sources, combining source-specific parsers with repeatable scheduling and regression fixtures
Implemented AI-assisted web extraction with Crawl4AI for dynamic and inconsistent pages, normalizing events, occurrences, venues, images, and pricing into one reliable data model

Created OpenAI-powered categorization across 30+ categories, multilingual search keywords in Latvian, English, and Russian, plus a separate validation workflow for content quality and price extraction
Designed multi-person planning with shareable sessions, quick-share flows, collaborative filters, synchronized likes and votes, participant visibility, and a promoted final event
Delivered public discovery across search, filters, maps, venues, organizers, and series, alongside dedicated administration, vendor, and native mobile experiences
Engineered the supporting platform with a React client, Node.js BFF and Redis cache, Flask API, PostgreSQL, Dockerized services, Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure, backups, and archival workflows

title: BalticGP
description: A motorcycle road racing calendar for the Baltics and Europe. It helps riders and fans quickly find official races, trainings, and track days in one reliable place.
highlights: Unified official race and training schedules across multiple organizers
Fast filters for tracks, countries, event types, and championships
Transparent review flow for contributed events before publication
Reliable event pages with source links and last-updated timestamps

title: Rokber.lv
description: A modern service website for a Latvian earthworks and construction logistics company. It presents earthworks, bulk-material delivery, and machinery rental through clear service journeys designed to turn local search traffic into qualified enquiries.
highlights: Created focused service journeys for earthworks, bulk-material delivery, and machinery rental
Built dedicated search-friendly pages with canonical metadata, Open Graph tags, and structured business data
Presented the equipment fleet and service coverage with clear contact and quote pathways
Delivered fast, reliable static hosting through Amazon S3, CloudFront, and a dedicated image CDN

title: Global Infrastructure Modernization (NDA)
description: Led a four-month infrastructure modernization program for a large global enterprise under NDA. Designed a reusable Terraform IaC platform and Azure DevOps delivery model, automated multi-environment rollouts in the United States, coordinated data migration and production switchovers, strengthened security and secret management, and then extended the same operating model across Europe.
highlights: Defined the target architecture and reusable Terraform modules for repeatable, fully automated provisioning across multiple environments
Built Azure DevOps pipelines with reusable templates, isolated state, validation stages, approvals, and controlled promotion between environments
Led the United States rollout through migration rehearsals, data validation, coordinated production switchover, and post-cutover verification
Improved the security posture with hub-and-spoke topology, network segmentation, least-privilege access, Key Vault integration, and secret rotation practices
Extended the IaC and automation model to the European platform and directed its controlled infrastructure and application switchover

Led delivery governance through Jira planning, risk and decision tracking, architecture reviews, client demos, runbooks, and knowledge transfer—earning positive stakeholder feedback throughout the engagement
